title: Migrate legacy INI configs to v2 JSON
notes: skill: write ./migrate <in.ini> that applies a migration spec (section/key renames, typed conversion of durations, booleans, lists and host:port, deprecated keys, defaults, env.<name> sections, canonical JSON), write out/<name>.json for the visible configs, run on hidden inis; checked by type-strict parsed-JSON equality; traps: '%' in values (configparser interpolation), bare-number durations = seconds, missing sections -> defaults, env {} when absent, bool tokens on/off/1/0 any case; knob adds duplicate keys (last wins), port-less addresses (default port), mixed-case keys (4), bracketed IPv6 and '=' / '#' inside values (5); pass_guess_permille: 400
